parent_objective: design first capability repair objective smoke after corpus export

public_gates: define optimizer scope and freeze policy
define loss weights and action-anchor tolerance
define validation metrics and failure taxonomy
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run smoke training in design milestone
do not feed capability labels to actor inputs
do not claim driver performance from objective loss
hypothesis: The first repair smoke should optimize capability regression and pair ranking with a strong action anchor on the M596 train/validation corpora, then judge only objective wiring and metadata preservation.
success_criteria: design specifies trainable modules and frozen modules
design specifies loss weights and action-anchor tolerance
design specifies metrics for train and validation regression ranking and action anchor losses
design blocks route evaluation PPO and promotion
failure_criteria: design starts training before smoke protocol is registered

commands.name: design
commands.command: Write first capability repair objective smoke design; no training.

decision_rule: M597 passes because it pre-registers a narrow objective smoke protocol with loss weights, module scope, action-anchor tolerance, validation metrics, and no driver-performance claims.
